verdict.rationale: The evidence describes many filing services, including formation, name reservation, standing certificates, UCC filings and apostilles. No item publishes a fee amount for any transaction. A filing agency could clearly publish its statutory fees, so the axis applies; with no fee amounts in evidence, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form
